reconciled_rows.title: Trace the helping aspect before choosing a means

source_locator.passage_anchor: If that the Lord of the second or the Moon doe promise substance
source_locator.anchor_note: Locating incipit/topic; long-s, spacing and glyph names normalized. Not a diplomatic quotation.

reconciled_rows.source_statement: When second lord or Moon promises substance through their mutual aspect, inspect the house from which the aspect comes or the house ruled by the Moon. If neither promises substance, inspect Fortune's house and its dispositor's house lordship.
qualifications_and_limits: These are conditional alternatives, not an instruction to collect every possible house narrative.

reconciled_rows.title: Helpful second lord: existing capital and commerce

source_locator.passage_anchor: if the Adjuvant Planet be Lord of the second
source_locator.anchor_note: Locating incipit/topic; long-s, spacing and glyph names normalized. Not a diplomatic quotation.

reconciled_rows.source_statement: A helping second lord signifies increasing and managing one's own stock; buying and selling things to which the person is naturally inclined, which arise in the course of life, or which suit the planet's nature, with its sign considered.
prerequisites: The planet actually assists or promises increase.

reconciled_rows.title: Sixth and a human sign: service and labour

source_locator.passage_anchor: If the Lord of the sixth, or Significator, or assistant Planet be in the sixth
source_locator.anchor_note: Locating incipit/topic; long-s, spacing and glyph names normalized. Not a diplomatic quotation.

reconciled_rows.source_statement: The sixth lord, significator or helping planet being in the sixth, with a human sign on the sixth, indicates good servants and profit from their labour; for a king/prince the continuation describes subjects' subsidies and loans.
qualifications_and_limits: Grammar leaves the exact scope of the human-sign and occupancy qualifications across the following occupational examples unresolved.

reconciled_rows.title: South node's house-specific impediment

source_locator.passage_anchor: in what House you find Cauda Draconis
source_locator.anchor_note: Locating incipit/topic; long-s, spacing and glyph names normalized. Not a diplomatic quotation.

reconciled_rows.source_statement: The south node is assigned detriment in the topics of its house: in second, estate consumption by folly/neglect; in third, difficulty through kin; analogize through other houses.
qualifications_and_limits: Historical source symbolism, not a supported claim about present people.

reconciled_rows.title: Ordinary recovery through received malefic

source_locator.passage_anchor: if an infortunate Planet be in the eighth, or Lord of the eighth
source_locator.anchor_note: Locating incipit/topic; long-s, spacing and glyph names normalized. Not a diplomatic quotation.

reconciled_rows.source_statement: A malefic in or ruling eighth that receives Ascendant lord or Moon can give the desired recovery. Without reception the source predicts hardly ever obtaining it, or such labour that the requester regrets it.
qualifications_and_limits: Hardly ever / if ever is not rewritten as an absolute impossibility; reception direction is material.

reconciled_rows.title: Received malefic in superior-payment enquiry

source_locator.passage_anchor: Moon and Lord of the Ascendant be joyned to an unfortunate Planet
source_locator.anchor_note: Locating incipit/topic; long-s, spacing and glyph names normalized. Not a diplomatic quotation.

reconciled_rows.source_statement: Moon and Ascendant lord joining a malefic that receives them into its essential dignities signify payment after much solicitation, weary approaches, fear and distrust.
qualifications_and_limits: Joining, reception, and named querent significators are preserved. The difficult path is separate from whether payment occurs.

reconciled_rows.title: Timing requires the actual effective significator

source_locator.passage_anchor: unto what Planet either the Lord of the Ascendant or Moon applyes
source_locator.anchor_note: Locating incipit/topic; long-s, spacing and glyph names normalized. Not a diplomatic quotation.

reconciled_rows.source_statement: Choose the planet to which Ascendant lord or Moon applies or bodily joins and which signifies accomplishment; in a sextile/trine case, whether that planet is a benefic or not, and whether it receives the Ascendant lord or Moon or not, inspect the rays through perfection or the degrees lacking to exact aspect/conjunction at the question.
qualifications_and_limits: Time-to-contact astronomy and symbolic distance-to-time are distinct. Static distance does not compute a moving contact date.

reconciled_rows.title: Ancients' same-sign conjunction route: heavier querent lord

source_locator.passage_anchor: Some of the Ancients have said
source_locator.anchor_note: Locating incipit/topic; long-s, spacing and glyph names normalized. Not a diplomatic quotation.

reconciled_rows.source_statement: Some ancients are reported to time accomplishment to exact degree-and-minute conjunction when the effective planet and Ascendant lord are in the same sign at the hour of the question and Ascendant lord is the more ponderous planet, whether reception exists or not.
qualifications_and_limits: Attributed prior view, not silently Lilly's own universal rule; ponderous does not mean merely comparing current daily velocity.

reconciled_rows.title: Ancients' lighter querent lord requires reception

source_locator.passage_anchor: if the Lord of the Ascendant be the more light Planet
source_locator.anchor_note: Locating incipit/topic; long-s, spacing and glyph names normalized. Not a diplomatic quotation.

reconciled_rows.source_statement: When the lighter Ascendant lord hastens toward conjunction, the effecting planet receiving it signifies accomplishment; the nonreception denial is subject to the following angular/domicile exceptions.
prerequisites: The two planets were in the same sign at the question, under the preceding attributed ancient method.
qualifications_and_limits: This is a different branch from the ponderous-lord condition. Read with LI.1647.II.XXVII.R838; the reception branch must not erase those exceptions.

reconciled_rows.title: Conjunction-route exceptions when reception absent

source_locator.passage_anchor: unlesse the foresaid significators be in an Angle
source_locator.anchor_note: Locating incipit/topic; long-s, spacing and glyph names normalized. Not a diplomatic quotation.

reconciled_rows.source_statement: Without that reception, accomplishment is denied unless the significators are angular at conjunction, or in one of his own houses, especially the house called his joy.
qualifications_and_limits: Own houses refers to zodiacal domiciles in the following sign examples. The pronoun his and its scope over the two significators remain ambiguous.
